title: feat(contacts): Add contact and privacy journeys
body:
Adds injectable trusted-contact and privacy UI for the existing shared app. Drivers can list their own contacts, request explicit scopes and revoke standing sharing. A contact can read a known trip’s protected location, read a known incident, record an acknowledgement or their own action, and revoke a known trip grant. Uncertain writes retain the original key/body for explicit retry; protected facts disappear before revoke and on session replacement. Acknowledgement, reported action, source-aged location, unknown delivery and driver-only resolution remain separate.

Frozen candidate: `cf32104a666860a69e745a1d1fbf8b12a4af64f6`. The latest delta from efe1629 changes only the existing test composer to select the reviewed shared session helper and record its immutable source; earlier efe1629 was README spacing only. The UI slice remains frozen at `e2c1e677cf3ec3fa9c7f91529b082ab5b8ff91e6` (14 owned files); source-age correction `1fd365ee7805cd83b2b1a1706973788dea6f805e` changes 6 owned files, and the latest follow-up changes only the existing 401 view regression; the complete PR stays within `web/src/features/contacts/**`, `web/src/features/privacy/**` and matching tests. Base remains Robert’s backend `ebc8fb1d36f441ef012ca585201cefabf61383d6`. Shared foundation, API, package/lock, router, entry and backend files are not copied or changed here.

`createContactRoutes({api,session,gateway,incidentReference?,grantReference?})` supplies the four approved registry slots: contacts, invitation, contactTrip and privacy. Its test composer consumes foundation PR56 `3283fe675ebeee04bb2be8a62f42ab5c475b4b0e` and API PR59 base `db7034fc9e1dba035b87368117376e9730d6b830`, then selects only `web/src/lib/api/journeys.ts` from reviewed PR81 exact `75bdffa42d858c82a8dcb0af11bc78803e3d9a09` (Git blob `3e41dc9fe23621a29ec6731f71f902e90ccafa1c`). The receipt records this helper commit/path/blob; every other API file keeps its old base. The host must share one API/MemorySession/gateway and separately activate each feature’s verified `/v1/me` binding. The contact-only trip selector permits a null driver identity without inventing one; owner selection and driver resolution guards are unchanged. UUID hints provide no permission and never render incident facts without the protected read and trip match.

Recipient discovery now has an unadopted draft backend candidate, [PR86 exact `44b104215882ada173a956045b1b0a108c00db46`](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/86/commits/44b104215882ada173a956045b1b0a108c00db46). Its published contract supplies only the two actor-bound invitation/trip lists, with IDs/scopes, server readAt and a fixed100/hasMore bound; earlier requests for extra detail routes are superseded. This candidate has not been independently accepted or bound through the shared API into this UI. The invitation page therefore still explains that requested scopes cannot yet be reviewed and keeps acceptance unavailable; participant-authorized withdrawal can use the known route grant ID. Under the development freeze this is inventory only, with shared API45/UI51 adoption awaiting Brain’s direction after reviews. The owner catalog follows PR65 exact `748d30c6e6c595fd1a2c2c648a045750de3dd9c8`, preserves historical accepted/revoked scopes and truncation, and is not incoming invitation discovery. Robert/44 must coordinate the remaining reads and planned status/sharing contracts. No lookup, DTO, emergency number, permission, history, research or notification capability is invented. Route disposal clears local command/receipt state without reconciling or cancelling an unknown server outcome; the UI says leaving does not cancel it and claims no persisted operation history.

Current correction on Node24.17.0 / TypeScript5.9.3: 30 journey/privacy/source-age tests pass, also from a fresh archive of1fd365e, and strict compile-only assertions reject an unanchored client clock. At the retained e2c1e67 UI freeze, 22 standalone journey/privacy tests and 6 tests through the actual typed client/gateway/binding passed. The existing 3 signed-JWT/PostgreSQL scenarios pass again with a fresh private Unix-socket cluster, which was stopped and removed. The composed foundation build and strict source/fixture typecheck pass. Browser builder evidence covers 40 route/locale/viewport cases (ES/PT-BR at390/1440/1920/360/430px) plus13 focused controls/states: trusted keyboard, input/scope validation, duplicate-submit suppression, separate receipts and escaped reports, session clearing, rejected same-key retry, permission/error/empty/truncated states, missing references, reduced motion and the narrow phone response action. Viewport/full-page captures are supplied for independent review. Whitespace checks pass.

Reproduce from the owned README using `node web/tests/contacts/compose-ui.mjs`; it archives the immutable shared dependencies into a disposable folder and copies only owned feature/tests, recording source HEAD/working state. Its development-only fixture renders the real foundation/API/controller with synthetic in-memory HTTP replies and identities. Those browser/client checks are not browser OIDC, persisted UI reload, physical-device, provider delivery or independent acceptance evidence. The normal production entry still needs integrator44 to mount this registry with a trusted host and the actual backend read routes. The existing backend persisted tests are distinct from the synthetic UI fixture. Production build success currently compiles the new components; it does not claim the default entry registers them or establishes their production bundle cost.

Earlier fix evidence stays bounded: [Q45 closed its original retry-state finding at b95bdba](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/62#issuecomment-6243021647), and [Q43’s subsequent review explicitly covers5c15183](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/62#pullrequestreview-5560631743), superseding its e78-only pass. All three reported README spacing nits, including the later reports14 observation, are fixed. Neither acceptance is promoted to this new UI/observation bridge. Fresh exact-SHA auth/privacy43 and functional UI52 reviews are required, along with shared dependency reviews. Component44 alone integrates after all live discussion, inline threads, formal COMMENTED findings and relevant issue feedback are resolved and Robert’s separate approval is obtained. No merge, main push, deployment, collection or live sends occurred.

Refs #15
Refs #35
Refs #14


Q59’s [new COMMENTED source-age P2 at e2c1e67](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/62#pullrequestreview-5560699766) was reproduced using the original immutable16d51a1 probe without edits. The correction at1fd365e removes the nowMs parameter and returns raw server ageMs/freshness/readAt with explicit asOf:server-read; it computes no current age. Client offsets/rollback cannot change it, and the backend-accepted +300ms capture retains its server-clamped0 instead of becoming null. [Baseline observations and exact archive provenance](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/blob/1fd365ee7805cd83b2b1a1706973788dea6f805e/web/tests/contacts/location-age-baseline.json) are retained; the original probe has a hardcoded older21cd50 tag, explicitly distinguished from the executede2c archive. Eight new controls fail against that old source and pass the correction. Actual UI files already displayed raw age/freshness as-of-read and do not call this helper, so the existing browser/PG evidence stays scoped toe2c rather than being promoted. [Q59 formally confirmed the original source-age finding fixed at this exact SHA](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/62#pullrequestreview-5560758393). Q43 confirmation remains separate and pending; broader UI52 acceptance is also separate. No retired PR53 projection, new status/discovery route or safe/asleep inference is introduced.


Review-only freeze inventory: [Q52’s original P2 recovery finding](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/62#pullrequestreview-5560763168) now has [original-reporter technical confirmation of the exact shared correction at75bdffa](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/81#pullrequestreview-5560798217). **The existing default test composer now selects that exact reviewed helper at cf32104; the affected existing 401 recovery test passes.** The prior default-pin failure remains preserved at efe1629 and in Q52’s old-helper controls. Original reporter52 source-only confirmation of this pin delta is requested; broader review/human feedback and production integration remain held. At1fd365e/e2c with pinned API db7034f, authenticated trip → location refresh401 clears protected facts/session and signs out the gateway, but a captured listener invokes a disposed binding and republishes verifying, leaving the Gate loading without recovery. Earlier green tests checked data clearing and did not establish that final recovery state.

The test-only follow-up at `364c4a4213a5d26b760e144f2c4e732e9a990596` extends that existing regression: both views must finish closed with an anonymous session/signed-out gateway and null protected facts; an explicit gateway.begin() must restore both ready states, verified actors, location, incident and catalog. It fails against the original pinned helper (verifying versus closed). All6 existing view tests pass in a disposable review fixture with only `web/src/lib/api/journeys.ts` taken from [Q45’s corrective PR81 exact `75bdffa42d858c82a8dcb0af11bc78803e3d9a09`](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/81/commits/75bdffa42d858c82a8dcb0af11bc78803e3d9a09). That blob differs only in guarding notification reset after disposal; direct dispose clearing remains intact. No contact implementation guard is added and no API source is copied into this branch. At cf32104 the composer retains db7034f for all other API files and overlays only the reviewed75bd journeys.ts, making this strengthened regression green in the default disposable test composition. The prior helper Git blob `9c00a982a56493be2fbf8fc95ab60bca9f39bc69`, failing fixture and original red log remain preserved; the helper’s reviewed replacement is `3e41dc9fe23621a29ec6731f71f902e90ccafa1c` with SHA256 `a76892f47d0ad6b9ddcf75c78e849d38c7ef98e8c04796ace77fcbe8d71b685d`. This is isolated helper evidence, not acceptance/adoption of the full API81 candidate or a new browser qualification. [Q52 independently confirmed the exact current efe1629 source with old API db7034f plus only the repaired75bd journeys.ts](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/62#issuecomment-6243753671): all6 current view tests plus its unchanged original oracle pass7/7, versus5/7 with the old helper; native read401/write401 and activation of the existing access button recover both cases with prior private drafts/receipts cleared. Its [portable reviewer evidence at ab61a6a7b738288f1e19ba2253dccf95eb8ec3c3](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/blob/ab61a6a7b738288f1e19ba2253dccf95eb8ec3c3/review-probes/client-401-75bdffa/README.md) verifies31 exact blobs and preserves the old failures. This confirms the narrow supplied-helper combination only; identities/HTTP remain synthetic, and full API81 adoption/current-head47/43 review roles remain separate.

Brain authorised only this existing-finding remediation within the development freeze. No new capability, recipient binding, production composition, broad proof campaign, merge or deployment was started. Shared API81’s current-head47/43 reviews, Q43 source-age correction confirmation, all actionable human/COMMENTED feedback and Robert’s approval remain separate gates. The prior UI evidence and every published branch are preserved. No whole-PR acceptance or merge permission is claimed.


[Q43’s new privacy/auth ACCEPT](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/62#pullrequestreview-5560781019) explicitly reviews frozen UI `e2c1e677cf3ec3fa9c7f91529b082ab5b8ff91e6`, although GitHub attaches it to364c4a4. Its22 unit/6 old-regression/3 persisted/4 independent store probes and strict types remain evidence for that declared source scope. It does not confirm the later source-age correction or replace Q52’s separate supplied-helper confirmation or the requested source-only pin-delta confirmation. The two reported README spacing nits, cover390 and plus13, are corrected in docs-only `efe1629d70374b1202c7535161b3c07f59c8af46`; whitespace checks pass. Renderer, source-age implementation and the364c4a4 recovery regression are unchanged by this documentation follow-up. The author browser count remains53 synthetic controls; Q43 did not rerun a Chrome harness.




Brain explicitly authorised only the existing reviewed dependency-selection correction at cf32104. Author verification ran just the affected existing401/recovery test through the default composer:1/1 pass. All9 API blobs match the declared base plus the one helper selection;21 feature/test files remain byte-identical to efe1629. The committed composer blob is `ddded5bda9d8dba0d67d5aef9909ac7d0686dde0`, matching the tested copy. Whitespace checks pass. Q52 is asked to confirm only this source pin delta against its already-tested combination; no broader browser rerun is requested. Q44 receives the exact handoff. No recipient SDK, full API81, feature/UI source or production composition is adopted, and no new capability, merge or main push is authorised.
